original_goal: Make DroidSpaces genuinely usable on 3917JR by restoring the host-kernel namespaces, TUN/TAP, VETH, bridge and container capabilities that root or Magisk cannot add at runtime.
thesis: To repair DroidSpaces, rescue a public Yulong/Coolpad kernel tree that compiled but did not reproduce the production device, then restore missing OEM implementations, replacement-module ABI and closed HAL interface compatibility through evidence-led iteration.

private_dependency_layers.method: port GPL or public same-IC implementations and validate against production behavior
rebuild and sign against the candidate Module.symvers, then audit real imports
private_dependency_layers.composition: 32 Qualcomm external-tree modules plus 5 in-tree core modules; stock br_netfilter became built-in

private_dependency_layers.method: restore the kernel UAPI and behavior expected by the production HAL; keep proprietary binaries local

evidence_levels.measured: verified on the device, in logs, dump or a real workload
evidence_levels.located: closed by a call stack, disassembly or controlled comparison
evidence_levels.inferred: plausible but not strong enough to state as root cause
evidence_levels.offline: built or inspected without an on-device result

r16_validation.duration: more than 15 hours in the 2026-08-05 validation window

docker.storage_driver: VFS used because Android F2FS was unsuitable as this 4.19 OverlayFS upperdir
passed: Nginx host port 18080 to container port 80 HTTP 200

non_claims: R16 is not a persistent-flash release.
R16 is not yet a bit-identical reproducible build.
R16 is not yet a CIP-updated kernel.
Camera success was not kernel-only; it included a local proprietary CHI compatibility step.
R13 had no on-device boot result.
R15 did not prove an Android data-password decryption failure.
Goodix fingerprint was not in the R16 final acceptance scope.
Docker cgroup CPU memory and I/O limits were not proven usable.

publication_rules.historic_media_status: the seven temporary screenshots named by the old script no longer exist; re-record or use clearly labeled evidence cards
